Instructional prompt format establishes a template: "Given the following topic, write an explanation about the impact of the year" sets up a structured Q&A pattern.

The "Topic" field specifies a conditional rule about year-based explanations, so the model must apply this rule to the given topic "The impact of the year on the game."

"Answer:" is the final token, functioning as a label introducing the model's response to the preceding instruction, requiring an explanation of how the year impacts the game, likely beginning with a sample output or demonstration.
"Instruction: [rule about year-based explanation]
Topic: [game description]
Answer:" — this structured format demands the next tokens be the actual explanatory response text, likely starting with "The" or a direct statement about the explanation format.
